material.locator: Society of American Archivists, “Archives 101: Basic Principles”, “Principle of Provenance” and “Arrangement” paragraphs. Page status: PRELIMINARY DRAFT.
material.description: The page states that materials of one provenance should not be intermingled with another and that a discernible original order should preferably be retained. The page is explicitly marked PRELIMINARY DRAFT and is used only as an introductory illustration, not as an adopted professional standard.
